sources.title: [26.16] -!!!!NERFED!!!!- The Poppy Support Encyclopedia - Eleven Years of Knowledge

passive.name: Iron Ambassador
passive.text: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

spells.name: Hammer Shock
spells.text: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

spells.name: Steadfast Presence
spells.text: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.text: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

spells.name: Keeper's Verdict
spells.text: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

archetype.value: Poppy is a tank that plays to scale rather than relying on early lane bullying.

axis.value: Poppy can poke with Q, but should play to scale before maxing Q.

winCondition.value: Poppy stays useful when behind by grouping and playing fights smart.

spikes.why: Poppy is effective on a low-economy tank build, making a third item a luxury in many games.
Poppy benefits from buying it early thanks to Steadfast Presence’s passive.

spikes.at: When Steadfast Presence reaches its 12-second cooldown
spikes.why: Poppy can activate its dash-stopping effect more often.

mistakes.value: Poppy misses a temporary shield if she does not pick up her buckler.
